{{Youmay|the rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]]|the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Mentor|consciousness]] on [[Zadd]]}}
'''Mentor''' was a rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]], bestowed upon members who had successfully recruited and trained eight [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] into the society. The rank was not given lightly; the potential Mentor must also have been a member in good standing and have the skills and experiences to train fellow smugglers. Mentors accounted for fifteen percent of the Black Bha'lir's membership.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
